channel.title: Iced Coffee on Barista At Home
channel.description: Recent content in Iced Coffee on Barista At Home

item.title: Japanese Iced Coffee Recipe: Flash-Brewed Over Ice (The Fastest Iced Coffee Method)
item.description: Japanese iced coffee is hot pour-over brewed directly onto ice — finished in 4 minutes, brighter and cleaner than cold brew. Full recipe with the 1:15 brew + 1/3 ice ratio, why flash-brewing preserves aromatics, and Japanese vs cold brew comparison.

item.title: Vietnamese Coconut Coffee (Cà Phê Dừa): Recipe, Hot & Iced Versions, and the Hanoi Origin Story
item.description: How to make Vietnamese coconut coffee (cà phê dừa) — the iced phin-brewed coffee topped with a sweet, frosty coconut slushy made famous by Cộng Cà Phê in Hanoi. Full recipe, hot version, calorie and caffeine breakdown, and how it differs from a coconut latte.

item.title: Iced Americano vs Iced Coffee: Caffeine, Taste, Calories Compared
item.description: Iced americano vs iced coffee: an iced americano is espresso + cold water + ice; iced coffee is brewed coffee chilled and poured over ice. Iced americano has more caffeine per ounce, sharper taste, fewer calories.

item.title: Iced Cortado Recipe: Equal Parts Espresso and Cold Milk Over Ice
item.description: How to make an iced cortado — a 4 oz Spanish espresso drink with equal parts cold milk and double espresso poured over ice. Stronger than an iced latte, smoother than straight espresso.

item.title: Iced Flat White Recipe: Ristretto Shots, Cold Whole Milk, No Foam
item.description: How to make a Starbucks-style iced flat white at home in 4 minutes — 2 ristretto shots over cold whole milk and ice. Stronger and creamier than an iced latte.

item.title: Thai Iced Coffee (Oliang) — Authentic Recipe & Home Barista Guide
item.description: How to make Thai iced coffee at home: traditional Oliang spice blend, condensed milk + evaporated milk float, Thai vs Vietnamese iced coffee comparison, and an espresso shortcut.

item.title: Iced Macchiato Recipe: How to Make It at Home (Layered, Not Stirred)
item.description: An iced macchiato is espresso shots poured over cold milk and ice — the reverse of an iced latte. 5-minute recipe with layering technique, 5 variations, and a comparison table.

item.title: Caramel Frappuccino Recipe: How to Make Starbucks Copycat at Home
item.description: Make a caramel frappuccino at home in 5 minutes — espresso, caramel sauce, milk, and ice blended to perfection. Includes hot, iced, and frozen versions, plus dairy-free swaps.

item.title: Espresso vs Cold Brew: Key Differences Explained
item.description: Espresso uses heat and pressure for a 30-second extraction. Cold brew steeps in cold water for 12–24 hours. Here's how they compare in caffeine, acidity, flavor, and when to use each.

item.title: Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew Recipe: Starbucks Copycat You Can Make at Home
item.description: Make Starbucks pumpkin cream cold brew at home — cold brew topped with pumpkin cream cold foam. Includes the pumpkin spice syrup recipe, dairy-free version, and year-round tips.

item.title: Coffee Frappe Recipe: How to Make a Frappe at Home (3 Methods)
item.description: How to make a coffee frappe at home — espresso frappe, Greek frappe, and blended frappuccino-style. Includes recipes, ratios, and variations.

item.title: What Is Cold Brew Coffee? Complete Guide to Cold Steep Coffee
item.description: Cold brew is coffee steeped in cold water for 12–24 hours — no heat involved. Learn how it's made, why it tastes different, types (concentrate, nitro), and how to brew it at home.

item.title: Spanish Latte Recipe: Creamy Condensed Milk Coffee (Hot & Iced)
item.description: Make a Spanish latte at home — espresso + condensed milk + steamed milk. Includes hot and iced versions, exact ratios, and tips for the perfect sweetness balance.

item.title: Cold Brew vs Iced Coffee: What's the Real Difference?
item.description: Cold brew vs iced coffee — side-by-side comparison of flavor, strength, caffeine, acidity, cost, and how to make both at home. Clear, no-fluff guide.

item.title: Iced Americano Recipe: How to Make It at Home (Better Than Starbucks)
item.description: How to make a perfect iced americano at home — espresso over cold water and ice for a clean, bold iced coffee. Includes the Korean iced americano technique and 5 variations.

item.title: Dalgona Coffee Recipe: The Whipped Korean Coffee Cloud (1:1:1 Ratio + Why Only Instant Coffee Works)
item.description: Dalgona coffee is whipped instant coffee, sugar, and hot water in equal parts — beaten until it forms a thick caramel-colored cloud and spooned over cold milk. Full recipe, the chemistry of why only instant coffee will whip, and how it compares to Greek frappe and Vietnamese egg coffee.

item.title: How to Make Iced Coffee at Home (4 Methods)
item.description: Learn how to make iced coffee at home using four different methods: flash brew, cold brew, iced espresso, and Japanese iced coffee. Each method explained with exact ratios.

item.title: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew (Starbucks Copycat Recipe)
item.description: Make the Starbucks Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew at home in minutes. Cold brew + homemade vanilla sweet cream + vanilla syrup. Tastes identical, costs 1/5 the price.

item.title: Cold Brew Coffee Recipe: The Easiest Method That Actually Works
item.description: A simple, foolproof cold brew coffee recipe using a 1:8 ratio. Steep overnight, strain, and enjoy smooth, low-acid cold brew at home. Includes concentrate and regular versions.

item.title: Iced Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso: Starbucks Copycat Recipe (5 Min, 4 Pumps Syrup)
item.description: The viral Starbucks Iced Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso, made at home in 5 minutes — 2–3 blonde shots shaken with 4 pumps brown sugar cinnamon syrup, topped with oat milk over ice. Tastes identical for ~$0.50 vs $5.95.

item.title: Vietnamese Iced Coffee (Cà Phê Sữa Đá) — Recipe & Guide
item.description: How to make authentic Vietnamese iced coffee at home. Complete guide covering phin filter brewing, condensed milk ratios, coffee selection, and espresso machine shortcuts.

item.title: Iced Latte Recipe: How to Make the Perfect Iced Latte at Home
item.description: Make a café-quality iced latte at home in 5 minutes. The exact ratio, espresso tips, milk options, and how to avoid watery coffee over ice.
